fields.description: How the block's content appears; repeated items (cards, list items, accordion items, columns) appear one after another. None: shown as is. Not played in the editor or when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

fields.name: classes_animationspeed
fields.label: Motion Speed
fields.description: How fast the animation runs: 0.3, 0.6 or 0.9 seconds.

fields.name: classes_animationtrigger
fields.label: Animation Trigger
fields.description: When the block's animations run. On Scroll: when the block comes into view (at once if it is in view when the page opens). On Page Load: as soon as the block is ready, wherever it is on the page.

fields.name: anchorName
fields.label: Anchor name
fields.description: The section id: #links and Anchor List links jump to it; also the prefix of tab ids without their own ID.

validation.customErrorMsg: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. our-offices.

fields.name: tabsAriaLabel
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Names the tab list for screen readers (aria-label), e.g. Our services.

fields.name: tabsOrientation
fields.label: Orientation
fields.description: Vertical: the tab list is on the left of the content on desktop, above it on mobile.

fields.name: containerAnchor
fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.description: The id of the tabs block itself (start with anchor-). Use Anchor name for links to the section.

validation.customErrorMsg: Start with anchor-, then lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

fields.name: containerHide
fields.label: Hide block
fields.description: Hides the whole block on the page until it is turned off (shown faded in the editor).

fields.label: Tab ID prefix
fields.description: Prefix of the tab ids (e.g. our-offerings-item-1); not an anchor: use Anchor ID for links.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The label of the tab.

fields.name: tabId
fields.label: ID
fields.description: Links to #ID open this tab (deep link), e.g. overview (lowercase, no spaces). Leave empty for an id from the Tabs ID.

validation.customErrorMsg: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. overview.

fields.name: activeTab
fields.label: Active tab
fields.description: Shows this tab when the page loads (the first tab if no tab is active).

fields.name: fragment
fields.label: Fragment
fields.description: A page whose content (any components, e.g. Columns, Title, Text, Image, Button) is shown in the tab.

fields.name: tcsLogoAlt
fields.label: TCS Logo Alt Text
fields.description: Names the logo link for screen readers.

fields.name: tcsLogoLink
fields.label: TCS Logo Link
fields.description: Usually the locale Home page.

fields.name: tataLogoAlt
fields.label: TATA Logo Alt Text
fields.description: Names the logo link for screen readers.

fields.name: tataLogoLink
fields.label: TATA Logo Link
fields.description: Usually https://www.tata.com/.

fields.name: menuRootPath
fields.label: Menu root path
fields.description: Tablet and mobile menu: the pages below this page, from the published site (on the Navigation page only, when it has no menu list); a page of this site (e.g. /en/..., not the language master). Empty, or without pages in this site: the Menu root path of the Conversation Canvas in the same section.

fields.name: menuDepth
fields.label: Menu depth
fields.description: Levels of pages below the Menu root path in the menu (1 to 3). Empty: the Conversation Canvas's, else 1.

fields.name: headerOverlay
fields.label: Header over the first block
fields.description: At every width: whether the logo bar lies transparent over the page's first block, which then starts at the top of the page (the bar turns solid once the page scrolls). Auto: over an opening light Hero (as on Home).

options.name: Never (the page starts below the header)

fields.name: classes_anchor
fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.description: A unique ID of the block on the page, starting with anchor-, e.g. anchor-our-services; link to it with #anchor-our-services.

validation.customErrorMsg: Start with anchor-, then lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

fields.name: classes_hideblock
fields.label: Hide block
fields.description: Hides the whole block on the page until it is turned off (shown faded in the editor).

fields.name: titleType
fields.label: Title Type
fields.description: The heading level of the title, which also sets its size (desktop sizes; smaller on mobile). Use one H1 per page.

fields.name: titleHidden
fields.label: Hide Title
fields.description: The title stays available to screen readers.

fields.name: shortDescription
fields.label: Short Description
fields.description: Shown after the links.

fields.name: dateLabel
fields.label: Date label
fields.description: Shown before the date, e.g. Published.

fields.name: readingTime
fields.label: Reading time
fields.description: Minutes (e.g. 14, shown as "14 min read") or any text.

fields.name: listenLink
fields.label: Listen link
fields.description: An audio version of the page: shows the listen icon.

fields.name: download
fields.label: Download
fields.description: Shows the download icon (prints the page or saves it as PDF).

fields.name: socialShare
fields.label: Share
fields.description: Shows the share icon (share dialog, or the link copied).

fields.name: authorDesignation
fields.label: Author designation
fields.description: e.g. TCS Role.

fields.name: authorImageAlt
fields.label: Author image alt text
fields.description: Leave empty if the image is decorative.

fields.name: imageFormat
fields.label: Image type
fields.description: Default: the Image is a picture. Lotto: the Image is a Lottie animation file (.json).

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Image & Text: beside the text. Text split: in the text column (e.g. a chart). Background image and Card: behind the text.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image alt text
fields.description: Leave empty if the image is decorative.

fields.name: imagePosition
fields.label: Image position
fields.description: Image & Text: the image left or right of the text (from 600px wide; above it on smaller screens), or above or below the text on every screen.

fields.name: imagePositionMobile
fields.label: Image position (mobile)
fields.description: Image above or below the text on mobile (narrower than 600px for Image & Text, 900px for Text split). Default: as the Image position (Left and Right: above), or in the text order for Text split.

options.name: Default (10:9; 16:9 above or below the text; original in Text split)

fields.name: multiLinks
fields.label: Multiple links
fields.description: On: the Links list (authored before Link items). Off: the Primary and Secondary CTA. Link items are shown after them either way.

fields.name: links
fields.label: Links (authored before Link items)
fields.description: Kept for teasers authored before; add items with Add instead.

fields.name: linkArrow
fields.label: List arrow
fields.description: Right: the default arrows. Down right: the arrow of every link (List links, buttons, Text links) points down and right. None: List links without an arrow (buttons and Text links keep theirs). Links opening a new tab keep their own arrow.

fields.name: buttonsSideBySide
fields.label: Buttons side by side
fields.description: On: the CTAs and links in a row (wrapping when there is no room). Off: one below the other. List links always fill the width.

fields.name: stats
fields.label: Stats (authored before Stat items)

fields.name: statValue
fields.label: Stats Value
fields.description: A single line, e.g. 40%.
Kept for teasers authored before; add items with Add instead.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Image & Text: image and text side by side. Text split: title left, text, links and stats right. Background image: the image behind centered text. Card: a rounded card with the image behind its text.

fields.name: bgColor
fields.label: BG Color
fields.description: Only the background colour; set the space around the content with the Padding fields of the Additional tab.

fields.name: textAlignment
fields.label: Text alignment
fields.description: Layout default: left, centered for Background image and when Image & Text has no image.

fields.name: verticalAlignment
fields.label: Vertical alignment
fields.description: How the text and the image (or the two text columns) line up. Layout default: center, top for Text split.

fields.name: topSpacing
fields.label: Top spacing
fields.description: Page header: the larger space above a teaser that opens a page.
